Operation and driver
Interstate, for-hire open-deck hotshot/flatbed hauling. Documented freight includes machinery, agricultural/construction equipment, pipe/conduit and general freight suitable for this equipment. Preferred lanes include FL, GA, AL, MS, LA, TX, OK, TN, NC, SC and VA; this is a lane preference, not a complete historical states/mileage report or a requested territorial restriction.
Corey Antwann Whetstone-Bey is the driver identified in the available insurance records; Class A CDL, TWIC and tanker endorsement. DOB: April 29, 1985. Please verify the complete current driver schedule and experience through underwriting. Future hazmat is only a possibility: explain eligibility, required coverage/filings and whether a midterm change would be possible, separately from this quote; do not assume a hazmat operation or experience.

Coverage comparison
The attached GEICO renewal for 11/13/2026–11/13/2027 shows an estimated annual premium of $16,913, $1 million auto liability, $100,000 cargo with $2,500 deductible, general liability, and comprehensive/collision on truck and trailer with $2,500 deductibles. UM/UIM is rejected; towing/labor and rental reimbursement are not included. Please reconcile all limits and endorsements against the actual policy rather than relying solely on this summary.

Please quote $1 million auto liability; $100,000 cargo and a separately priced $250,000 option; $1 million/$2 million general liability; comprehensive/collision on BOTH units with $1,000 versus $2,500 deductibles; and applicable Florida coverages. For open-deck freight, confirm in writing coverage/exclusions for wetness, rust/corrosion, tarped loads, loading/unloading, securement damage, theft, unattended/overnight parking, debris removal and salvage. Do not achieve a lower price by silently reducing limits, excluding our freight, or restricting our operations.

I am requesting available records from my existing agent. Please provide a secure upload method and a concise checklist of the remaining items needed for your markets.

Please identify the insurers/markets you propose BEFORE submitting applications so overlapping submissions can be coordinated. Include insurer financial-strength rating, full premium by coverage, all taxes/fees/finance charges, down payment, installment schedule, full-term total, paid-in-full discounts, cancellation/minimum-earned terms, FMCSA filings and COI turnaround. Identify whether your proposal is preliminary or firm. This is a quote request only, not authorization to bind, cancel, make a broker-of-record change, or incur paid report charges.

Please respond by email with your itemized proposal and next steps.
